parole.significato: A snack consisting of two small round layers of cake covered in chocolate with marshmallow filling.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Korean 초코파이 (chokopai), itself from English choco + pie.

parole.significato: A South Korean dish made of sweet corn (often canned) and mozzarella cheese.
parole.testo: Calque of Korean 콘치즈 (konchijeu), itself a pseudo-anglicism from English corn + cheese.

parole.significato: A popular Korean card game played with hwatu cards, similar to the Japanese game of koi-koi.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Korean 고스톱 (goseutop), from English go + stop.

parole.significato: The elder members of a male K-pop group as a collective.
parole.testo: Calque of Korean 형 라인 (hyeong rain), composed of 형(兄) (hyeong, “hyung; elder brother of a man”) and 라인 (rain, “members with a shared characteristic”), ultimately from English line. By surface analysis, hyung + line. Refer to 라인 (rain, “members with a shared characteristic”) for more information.

parole.significato: A group of people born in a certain year (liners).
parole.testo: Borrowed from Korean 라인 (rain, “members with a shared characteristic”), itself from English line. Likely generalized via hyung line, maknae line, etc.

parole.significato: The younger members of a K-pop group as a collective.
parole.testo: From Korean 막내 라인 (mangnae rain), composed of 막내 (mangnae, “maknae; youngest person in a group”) and 라인 (rain, “members with a shared characteristic”), ultimately from English line. By surface analysis, maknae + line. Refer to 라인 (rain, “members with a shared characteristic”) for more information.

parole.significato: a multi-purpose building in Korea with both residential and commercial units
parole.testo: Borrowed from Korean 오피스텔 (opiseutel), a pseudo-anglicism from English office + hotel.
By surface analysis, queer + parade, but in regards to South Korean usage, it is a calque of Korean 퀴어 퍼레이드 (kwieo peoreideu), which is from English queer + parade.

parole.significato: A photographic portrait taken by the subject; a selfie.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Korean 셀카 (selka), from English self + camera.

parole.significato: A fan of the South Korean boy band SHINee.
parole.testo: From Korean 샤월 (syawol), shortening of Korean 샤이니 월드 (syaini woldeu, “SHINee World”), from 샤이니 (syaini, “SHINee”) and 월드 (woldeu) (from English world).

parole.significato: The elder members of a female K-pop group as a collective.
parole.testo: Calque of Korean 언니 라인 (eonni rain), composed of 언니 (eonni, “unnie; elder sister of a woman”) and 라인 (rain, “members with a shared characteristic”), ultimately from English line. By surface analysis, unnie + line. Refer to 라인 (rain, “members with a shared characteristic”) for more information.
